officialCustodyEvidence: Official Graz pages identify the Stadtvermessungsamt/Geoportal; the first-party geodaten.graz.at GBG service is titled KATASTER und Städtische Grundstücke and exposes the parcel layer.
limits: The municipal GBG layer is not evidence of nationwide Austrian cadastral coverage.
